title: Lifting a section to an integer extension map
statement: Let X be a topological space, F an abelian sheaf, U an open of X, and s ∈ F(U). Let E_U be the extension by zero to X of the constant integer sheaf on U [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. There exists f : E_U → F whose image of the canonical integer-one extension section over U is exactly s. No compactness, nonempty or stalkwise-only hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 00A5 (extension by zero adjunction); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00A5; integer generators used in Cohomology, Lemma 0A38, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A38

proof.text: Use the explicit local-integer-generator construction: send an integer to its multiple of the restriction of s on each image open of U. This natural additive presheaf map sheafifies to a morphism into F restricted to U. Apply extension by zero and compose with the restriction counit.

Reuse extensionSection_naturality and extensionSection_counit from the proved local-generator module, together with the sheafifyLift unit identity. The image-preimage identity transports the image-open restriction back to U; evaluating at integer one gives exactly s, also for empty U.

proof_origin.place: Extension-by-zero adjunction, specialized to constant integers; explicit unit compatibility as used in 0A38.

theorem abelianIntegerExtension_section_lift
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (F : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) (U : Opens X)
    (s : F.obj.obj (op U)) :
    ∃ f : (abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) ⟶ F,
      f.hom.app (op U) (abelianOpenExtensionSection U
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) U le_rfl
        ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
          ((Functor.const (Opens ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))ᵒᵖ).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
          (op ((Opens.map U.inclusion').obj U)) (ULift.up 1))) = s
